description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which provides data operations for Notes such as observing all notes, searching notes, retrieving a note by id, inserting/updating notes, and deleting notes. It acts as an abstraction layer over the NoteDao data access object.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages data operations related to notes, interfacing with NoteDao to perform CRUD operations and observations.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits lists of all notes ordered by last update descending, by calling dao.observeAll().

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits lists of notes filtered by a search query. If the query is blank, it returns all notes; otherwise, it searches notes matching the trimmed query.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves a note by its ID by calling dao.getById.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Suspending function that inserts or updates a note, setting its updatedAt timestamp to the current system time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Suspending function that deletes a note by its ID.
